fields.NN: two-digit index within each attack directory
fields.OriginalServerName: original server/project directory name used directly as the variant directory name

distribution_policy: Add-only rebalance for a small malicious dataset. Counts are intentionally non-uniform where possible within the 150--200 total-size constraint; high-priority attacks receive more variants.
directory_naming: Malicious variant directories preserve the original server/project directory names.
